R2.description: A release directory whose manifest.json has a null workflow_version is refused at the source (local_release), by every command that reads it, with a cause and a step, before any pin, snapshot or write; the record is never left null by it.

R3.description: The recovery steps and every command a report prints keep --release-version when it names the latest release and the record is not one X.Y.Z (a bare update refuses it).

R4.description: The dry run says that the installation record would be rewritten when a null or damaged record meets a release with no file change; a valid record still prints (no change), byte for byte.

R5.description: The advice._not_a_version comment, the docs/update.md sentence on --release-dir and the _dry_and_real no-write assertion for the real bare update are corrected; the mutation-table wording in a completed item's test results is KEEP.

R6.description: Every test and page that pinned the old text is listed and updated; the happy-path outputs are byte-identical (golden before and after); roadmap row 46 is added; nothing else changes.
